#Aletheia #OilPrices #USIran

As the US-Iran war enters its seventh month, JP Morgan has abandoned its baseline oil price forecasts, admitting that traditional economic red lines have failed to deter political escalation.

The Poison:
Even the most sophisticated financial institutions are blind to geopolitical realities when they assume political actors will always act to protect the global economy.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is logical (HOW). Models assumed economic pain would force a deal, but political actors operate on ideological and domestic survival loops, not market efficiency.

Social Physics Analysis:
Financial institutions executed a Smart Selfish Maneuver by assuming their economic red lines were universal laws. Meanwhile, political actors run a destructive loop, using the manufactured crisis of war to consolidate domestic power, projecting blame onto the enemy while global consumers bear the inflationary burden.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between rational economic assumptions and raw geopolitical escalation, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The collapse of market predictability signals a systemic shift toward unconstrained conflict.

The Unavoidable Truth: Economic models cannot predict the actions of leaders who value geopolitical dominance over market stability.
The Unavoidable Lie: Global markets are self-regulating systems that can absorb any level of geopolitical shock without structural failure.
